learning: Original aligned earlier normal rows, 100 percent. Separate cold/warm models; cold excludes the three personal-history dimensions. Exact marginal midrank Gaussian transformation, full covariance, context first/second moments shrunk to same-cold global model. Inclusive distance-reference tails, grouped/global tails mixed; unknown context global fallback. No sorted-column artifact used as joint training rows.
limits: Single elliptical relationship model after marginal transformation. In-sample normal distance reference is not held-out calibration. Existing zscore clipping is not recovered. No exact order inside coarse buckets, no verified low-amount anomaly labels. Score is not fraud probability/p-value or guaranteed false-positive rate.
mean_control: Equal-weight arithmetic mean of the two verified supervised scores, float64. An ensemble ranking score, not a calibrated fraud probability. Added before any copula fit after observing different performance directions in the first two deep folds; not an original-study preregistration.
selection: supervised>=a OR(novelty>=b AND supervised>=c); fixed b/c grid, all distinct a with ties, disabled heads preserved. Same full development population, four targets unchanged. Report threshold combinations, not unique alert sets.
evaluation_limit: Design responds to previous development errors; model/policy selection reuses past development labels. Not independent validation or deployment readiness; 2024 excluded from selection.
